alloy: all u: Unit | (unfounded[u] or miscited[u] or circular[u]) implies u in Finding
all u: Unit | unfounded[u] implies u in Freelancing
all spec_1: Spec | ((no a: Axiom | cites[spec_1, a]) and (no s: Spec | cites[spec_1, s])) implies spec_1 in Freelancing
all b: Bug | (some u: Unit | cites[b, u] and u not in Spec) implies b in Misnesting
all c: Conflict | (some u: Unit | cites[c, u]) implies c in Misnesting
all t: Term | (some u: Unit | cites[t, u]) implies t in Misnesting
all u: Unit | circular[u] implies u in Cycle
all c: Conflict | (some i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue and i not in Known) implies c in Mistracking
all c: Conflict | (some i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue and i in Closed) implies c in OutdatedTracking
all c: Conflict | not paired[c] implies c in Unpairing
all t: Test | misleading[t] implies t in Finding
all p: Pointer | (no t: Target | p->t in Name.pointer) implies p in Rotting
all u1, u2: Unit | u1->u2 in Repeat.rel implies u1 in Rotting
all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict) implies u in Orphaning
all f: Fence | f in ScenarioWord implies f in ScenarioBlock
all f: Fence | f in NoSecondWord implies f in UnitBlock
all f: Fence, u1: Unit | f->u1 in Within.rel implies u1->f in Blocks.rel
all d: Document, p: Plugin | (some l: Listing | d->l in Head.rel and lists[l, p]) implies p->d in Over.rel
all d: Document, p: Plugin | ((some l: Listing | d->l in Head.rel and not lists[l, p]) and (no r: Run | d in Given)) implies not (p->d in Over.rel)
all p: Plugin, d: Document, l: Listing | (d->l in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | l->e in Item.rel) and (no r: Run | d in Given)) implies not (p->d in Over.rel)
all f: Frontmatter | f in Looping implies f in Refused
all f: Stray | f in Refused
all r: Run, d: Document, f: Refused | d->f in Head.rel implies (d in Unreadable and r in Exits2)
all r: Run, p: Plugin | calls[r, p] implies (r->p in Return.code0 or r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2)
all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2) and (((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits1)
all r: Run | (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2
some r: Run, p: Installed, d: Document | calls[r, p] and p->d in Over.rel and r->p in Return.code1 and r in Exits1
some d: Document, f: Refused, r: Run | d->f in Head.rel and d in Unreadable and r in Exits2
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d in Worded and d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
all r: Run, c: Command, u: Unit | ((r->GenerateCommand in Ask.rel or r->CheckCommand in Ask.rel) and u in Faulted) implies (not (u in Explained) and r not in Exits0)
all u: Unit | u in Rewritten iff (u in Unwritten or u in Stale)
all u: Unit | u in Stale implies u in Rewritten
all w: Word | (some u: Unit | u not in Term and u->w in Introduce.rel) implies (some u2: Unit | u2 not in Term and u2->w in Introduce.rel)
doubt: Tautological: the implication holds trivially from the premise

alloy: all u: Unit, w: Word | (some v: Unit | u->w in Voice.rel and v->w in Introduce.rel and v != u) implies w in Apart
all w1: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w1 in Introduce.rel) and (no u1: Unit | u1->w1 in Rely.rel)) implies w1 in Unused
all u: Unit | u in BareFormula implies u in Held
all s: Search | (s in First and (no sc: Scenario | sc in Impossible)) implies s not in Trial
all s: Search, sc: Scenario | (s in Trial and s->sc in Pose.scenario) implies (s in Afterwards and sc in Impossible)

all s: Search, sc: Scenario, u1: Unit | (s in Trial and s->sc in Pose.scenario and u1 in Leave.rel[s]) implies (u1 in Held and u1 not in Pose.units[s] and (all u2: Unit | (u2 in Held and u2 != u1) implies u2 in Pose.units[s]))
all u1, u2: Unit | (u1 != u2 and (some w: Word | u1->w in Rely.rel and u2->w in Rely.rel)) implies u1->u2 in Together.rel
all u1, u2: Unit | u1->u2 in Together.rel implies u1->u2 in Chain.rel
all r: Run | (r->LogicCommand in Ask.rel and (no sc: Scenario | sc in Raised) and (no u: Unit | u in Contradicting)) implies r in Exits0
all r: Run, lc: LogicCommand | (r->lc in Ask.rel and ((some sc: Scenario | sc in Raised) or (some u1: Unit | u1 in Contradicting))) implies r not in Exits0
all u: Unit, w: Word | w not in Signature implies not (u->w in Expose.rel)
all t: Term, w: Word | not (t->w in Expose.rel)
all d: Document, u: Unit, w: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies not (u->w in Expose.rel)
all d: Definition | (d in OneKind and byKind[d]) implies d in OneSentenceKind
all d: Definition | d in NoKindFirst implies d in AsItStands
all d1: Definition | d1 in AmbiguousAnd implies d1 in AsItStands
all l: Series | sentenceable[l] implies l in AsSentence
all l: Series | (l in Items and not sentenceable[l]) implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in Many implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | (l in Rule and l not in OneLineRule) implies l in ThenOwnLine
some q: Quantifier | q in VariableOnce and q in NoWithAnother
some q1: Quantifier | q1 in VariableSubject and q1 in VariableTwice
some l: Series | l in PairInList and l in NotClause
some l: Series | l in Rule and l in TimeSecond and l not in OneLineRule
some l: Series | l in Rule and l in OneLineRule and l in TimeFirst
always (all o: Owner, c: Cleanup | (o in Disposed and c in Registered and c->o in on and c not in Ran) implies eventually (c in Ran))
